# Sparkco AI

> > Sparkco AI transforms natural language into live spreadsheets and intelligent automation workflows, with specialized solutions for healthcare providers and skilled nursing facilities.

Sparkco AI is an AI-powered platform that combines spreadsheet generation with agentic automation capabilities. The platform serves enterprise customers in healthcare, financial services, and operations, offering both direct spreadsheet tools and integration with EHR systems for clinical workflows.

## Key Topics

- AI Spreadsheet Agent
- Text-to-Excel
- Healthcare Automation
- Skilled Nursing Facilities
- EHR Integration
- Patient Referral Screening
- Insurance Verification
- Care Plan Automation
- Data Analysis
- Document Automation
- AI-Admissions
- Claude Sonnet 4.5
- HIPAA/BAA Compliance
- Financial Modeling
- Spreadsheet Generation

## Core Products

- [Sparkco: AI Excel Agent & AI Spreadsheet Modeler](https://sparkco.ai): Turn natural language into live spreadsheets with AI agent automation and real-time data modeling
- [Healthcare AI Agent for Skilled Nursing Facilities](https://sparkco.ai/healthcare): Best-in-class AI agent solution for healthcare automation, patient referral screening, and care management in skilled nursing facilities
